# sapintegrationsuite_api_management_certificate_store_reference (Data Source)

Reads a Classic API Management certificate store reference (CertificateStoreReferences) by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sapintegrationsuite_api_management_certificate_store_reference" "backend_trust" {
  name = "backend-trust-reference"
}

output "backend_trust_store" {
  value = data.sapintegrationsuite_api_management_certificate_store_reference.backend_trust.certificate_store_name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The certificate store reference's name to look up.

### Read-Only

- `certificate_store_name` (String)
- `id` (String) Always equal to name.
- `store_type` (String)
